caveats: Single-condition timing on an otherwise idle machine. Real campaigns additionally pay model loading, protocol resolution, result assembly and I/O per batch, and spot-instance retries.
The product of five planning factors is not a measurement. Changing any one changes the total proportionally.

campaigns_per_project.basis: PLANNING ASSUMPTION: one full recomputation per major model revision over four years.

donors.basis: PLANNING ASSUMPTION for per-donor parameterisation. The funded plan names 5 G1 donors for WP2 and 21 chips for RNA-seq.

pairwise_perturbations.basis: DERIVED from the model: 32 internal (non-input) nodes, each forcible ON or OFF, give 64 single perturbations and 64*63/2 = 2016 unordered pairs. It remains a PLANNING ASSUMPTION that pairs are screened at all; nothing in the funded work plan commits to it.

rate_sets.basis: PLANNING ASSUMPTION. The committed ensemble uses 30; 1000 is a uncertainty-quantification target, not a current practice.

scenarios.basis: MEASURED from the model: one variant per hypothesis family.

extrapolated.unit_basis: MEASURED: median CPU seconds for one 3-phase condition at 10,000 trajectories.
